pages.text: Pressed powder fired near its melting point densifies as its grains weld - faster hotter and pressed harder. But heat also grows the grains, and big grains make a weak ceramic. The art is dense and fine together.
$(thing)Set$(): Pressure, Temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Powder lot: the density varies by ±0.3%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): One pressing at a time.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Density: ρ(P, T)$(br)Grain size: g ∝ e^((T − 1600 K)/150 K)
